channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israel carries out double tap strike in central Gaza
item.description: Israel carries out double tap strike in central Gaza

item.title: Israel and the cost paradox of the Iran war
item.description: Israel instigated the war on Iran and yet it has borne few of its costs.

item.title: Israeli air strike on a vehicle in Gaza kills two Hamas security officials
item.description: The head of internal security for Hamas in central Gaza was among the dead.

item.title: Israeli crackdown in occupied West Bank intensifies, settlers cause mayhem
item.description: The surge in violence comes after four Palestinians and two soldiers were killed in a gunfight on Friday.

item.title: Iran’s army issues warning ahead of Netanyahu’s US visit
item.description: Iran says it has stopped retaliatory operations in the Gulf, but warns the war could expand if US strikes continue.

item.title: Malaysia to host rescheduled Bahrain Grand Prix F1 race in October
item.description: The race in Bahrain was rescheduled in April amid the US-Israel war on Iran and will now be held in Malaysia.

item.title: Anti-war protesters demand end to US use of UK airbase to strike Iran
item.description: Anti-war activists have protested outside a UK airbase over US forces using it to bomb Iran

item.title: Israeli settlers set fire to mosques, cars and farm land in West Bank, Palestinians say
item.description: The latest attacks come two days after a clash between settlers and Palestinians near the village of Tell, which left four Palestinians and two Israelis dead.

item.title: Ten killed in Russian attack on drone exhibition near Kyiv
item.description: The event, attended by prominent members of the Ukrainian defence industry, was hit by ballistic missiles in the middle of the day.

item.title: Iran-backed Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia
item.description: US military says it disabled a tanker that was attempting to evade the American blockade on Iranian ports.
